basic_info.description: Tucked away on a quiet, tree-lined street in Corona Heights, this stylish 3BR/2BA condo offers a blend of modern living and tranquil surroundings. The spacious living/dining area is filled with light, featuring oversized windows, oak floors, and a wood-burning fireplace. The remodeled kitchen includes granite counters, slate flooring, cherry cabinets, and high-end appliances: Viking range, GE microwave, U-Line wine cooler, and more. A bar-height counter connects to the dining areaperfect for entertaining. All 3 bedrooms are generously sized, including a primary suite with en-suite bath. Additional amenities: a 2nd full bath, private W/D, deeded storage, and 1-car garage w/EV charger. Step into a lush, terraced gardena true urban oasis. Just moments to Corona Heights Park, Buena Vista Park, trails, and sweeping city views. Close to the Castro, dining, shopping, and Muni. A serene escape in the heart of the city! HOA Dues are only $595/month and inlcude earthquake insurance!!
